intended_behavior: Establish a first application baseline only from Git-derived production absence, frozen expected cases, source-bound Python/V8 body execution, complete asset snapshots and exact schema-5 owner authorization. Preserve normal compatibility after introduction.
limits: Witnesses prove body execution and source identity; author-selected output cases and asset bytes do not certify semantic correctness or exhaustive behavior. No existing-production bootstrap or suppression of coverage is admitted.
